author: OwnPBX
description: Reseller accounts: each reseller is a tenant with their own sub-portal, their own extensions, their own trunk and their own billing. v1 is the foundation — reseller records, host-to-tenant resolution, and tenant scoping on the Users and Extensions lists. Trunk routing, dialplan islands, DID purchases, Stripe payments and white-label domains come later.
